from pyaedt import QExtractor, launch_desktop
import os

# Set non-graphical mode
nongraphical = True

# Launch AEDT and QExtractor
desktop = launch_desktop(specified_version="2024.1", non_graphical=nongraphical, new_desktop_session=True)
q2d = QExtractor(projectname="CPWG_2D_Extractor", designname="CPWG_Design", solution_type="Q2D Extractor", specified_version="2024.1")

# Define variables
q2d["wg"] = "3mm"      # Signal width
q2d["sg"] = "0.5mm"    # Gap between signal and ground
q2d["gndw"] = "10mm"   # Ground width
q2d["h"] = "1.6mm"     # Dielectric height
q2d["diel_x"] = "12mm" # Dielectric x size
q2d["diel_y"] = "4mm"  # Dielectric y size
q2d["coating"] = "0.05mm" # Conformal coating thickness

# Create signal trace (centered)
signal = q2d.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=["(diel_x-wg)/2", "(diel_y-h)/2+h"],
    dimension_list=["wg", "0.035mm"],
    name="Signal",
    matname="copper"
)

# Create coplanar ground (left)
coplanar_left = q2d.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=["(diel_x-wg)/2-sg-gndw", "(diel_y-h)/2+h"],
    dimension_list=["gndw", "0.035mm"],
    name="CoplanarLeft",
    matname="copper"
)

# Create coplanar ground (right)
coplanar_right = q2d.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=["(diel_x+wg)/2+sg", "(diel_y-h)/2+h"],
    dimension_list=["gndw", "0.035mm"],
    name="CoplanarRight",
    matname="copper"
)

# Create reference ground plane (bottom)
ref_gnd = q2d.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=["0", "(diel_y-h)/2"],
    dimension_list=["diel_x", "0.035mm"],
    name="RefGround",
    matname="copper"
)

# Create dielectric
dielectric = q2d.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=["0", "(diel_y-h)/2"],
    dimension_list=["diel_x", "h"],
    name="Dielectric",
    matname="FR4_epoxy"
)

# Create conformal coating
coating = q2d.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=["0", "(diel_y-h)/2+h"],
    dimension_list=["diel_x", "coating"],
    name="Coating",
    matname="solder"
)

# Assign conductor to signal
q2d.assign_single_conductor(signal, "Signal")

# Assign conductor to coplanar grounds
q2d.assign_single_conductor(coplanar_left, "CoplanarLeft")
q2d.assign_single_conductor(coplanar_right, "CoplanarRight")

# Assign reference ground
q2d.assign_single_conductor(ref_gnd, "RefGround", is_reference_ground=True)

# Assign Huray roughness model to signal
q2d.assign_huray_finitecond_to_edges(signal, roughness_value=0.5e-6, sphere_radius=0.5e-6, surface_ratio=2.0)

# Create setup
setup = q2d.create_setup(name="Setup1")
setup.props["Frequency"] = "1GHz"
setup.update()

# Analyze
q2d.analyze_setup("Setup1")

# Plot solution data (capacitance matrix)
solution_data = q2d.get_solution_data()
solution_data.plot("C", plot_type="rectangular", primary_sweep_variable="Freq")

# Save project and close AEDT
q2d.save_project()
q2d.close_project()
desktop.release_desktop()
```
